symptoms: high fever, severe headache, pain behind eyes, joint pain, muscle pain, skin rash, nausea, vomiting, bleeding gums, fatigue
prevention: Use mosquito nets, wear full-sleeved clothes, remove stagnant water around home, use insect repellent
when_to_see_doctor: If fever persists beyond 2 days, signs of bleeding, severe abdominal pain, persistent vomiting, or feeling very weak
home_care: Rest, drink plenty of fluids, take paracetamol for fever (avoid aspirin/ibuprofen), monitor for warning signs

symptoms: fever with chills, sweating, headache, nausea, vomiting, body ache, fatigue, shivering
prevention: Sleep under insecticide-treated bed nets, use mosquito repellent, eliminate stagnant water, take prophylaxis in endemic areas
when_to_see_doctor: If high fever with chills recurs, fever not improving after 3 days, signs of severe malaria (confusion, seizures)
home_care: Rest, stay hydrated, take prescribed antimalarials on time, eat light meals

symptoms: persistent cough for more than 2 weeks, coughing blood, night sweats, weight loss, fever, fatigue, loss of appetite
prevention: Cover mouth when coughing, ensure good ventilation, BCG vaccination for children, complete full TB treatment course

symptoms: prolonged high fever, headache, stomach pain, weakness, loss of appetite, constipation or diarrhea
